card.name: Space before a time span number
card.fires_on: The space (or the word "to") right after "after" or "for" when a length of treatment time follows, such as "after 7 to 10 days" or "for 1 week". It marks the spot just before the number of days, weeks or months.

modes.label: Space after "after"
modes.description: The blank slot between "after" and a number of days, weeks or months in dosing or follow-up instructions.
modes.example: increase to 10 mcg twice daily after<< >>1 month based on clinical response.

modes.label: Space after "for"
modes.description: The blank slot between "for" and a short treatment period at the start of dosing.
modes.example: Begin treatment at 30 mg once daily for<< >>1 week, to allow patients to adjust

modes.label: "to" inside a range
modes.description: The word "to" within a day range after "remit after 7".
modes.example: The failure of insomnia to remit after 7<< to>> 10 days of treatment may indicate

card.writes: It pushes toward time units of weeks and months and away from hours and times of day.
card.plain: It fires where a number of weeks or months of treatment is about to be named.
